A '''tractor pressor''' was an emitted beam that used [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor]] technology, but it would repel an object instead of drawing it closer. [[Pressor field|''Pressor'']] beams or [[Pressor field|''repulsor'']] beams could be used as type of weapon to drive back ones adversary and keep them at bay.
